English: Her father followed him and did not catch him
(who I am marrying off)
we paid twenty pounds.
until nothing more was left.

Matras_Jerusalem_Domari_2000: čirdom bāyiske demsi ʕašrīn līra badāl barimki.
Macalister_Domari_1914: ắmmă tírdōm wī zerd barōm-dḗriătă bo͡iúska
English: but I offered twenty pounds in the place of my brother to her father,

Matras_Jerusalem_Domari_2000: mištirde siryis bāyiski ū mangida mēšis.
Macalister_Domari_1914: Imcírdă má͡umŭs-siri u mámyisk ʕăstṓsis síriŭs, u wḗsre ŭnkī́săn panj u bá͡iŭs.
English: he kissed his wife's head and remained with them (old Domari: he kissed his uncle's head and wife's mother's hand and remained with them)
My brother came to me.
We asked the girl from him.
He wants me to marry him to his uncle's daughter.
"bring the money" (he said)
and were satisfied,

Matras_Jerusalem_Domari_2000: mangara/ kān biddo mēšīman talātīn līra
English: he wanted from us thirty pounds

Matras_Jerusalem_Domari_2000: māmis putur pardosas ū nasra mindžīs [harab fīha]
English: Her uncle's son took her and ran off with her.
and we bought two goats

Matras_Jerusalem_Domari_2000: bāyos ū barēs ū ʕealtos qēre.
Macalister_Domari_1914: u ḳắră bó͡iŭs i dà͡iŭs u bárŭs
English: and her father and mother and brother ate
and slaughtered them,
but we didn't have the money
and set rice and meat,
He did not wish to give her.

Macalister_Domari_1914: Mī́ndă ḥálos láci u zárō ílli pădṓsis, gārī́re.
English: The girl and the boy who took her (betook themselves and) returned.
